intro: Previously on your life: cereal over the sink. Tonight, a mysterious stranger arrives. Me.
{Name}at last, an audience. I've survived two comas, an evil twin and the devs.
Out of everyone on Monad, you picked me. I'd weep, but it's my good mascara.
ring: Darling, I'm calling from my own funeral.
Don't pick up. I deserve to suffer.
Answer, or I faint into the trifle.
wake: {Name}you're awake. I sat by your bed all night. Mostly for the charger.
Today on your life: {event} at {when}. And the return of the missing sock.
You picked up. Shame. I'd already minted your eulogy.
gm. I said it to the toaster at six. It never said it back.
If you're late, claim you were kidnapped. {event} at {when}. I'll write the ransom note.
Finally. I've been pacing the conservatory for hours. We don't have a conservatory.
I dreamt you ran off with my evil twin. I'm keeping the hoodie.
You're out of the coma. Eight hours. I've aged terribly.
snooze: We're done. I'm dumping you. See you in nine minutes.
Nine more minutes. Fine. My revenge is vesting.
Rugged. For a duvet. It's not even a nice duvet.
Paper hands, after everything. You had the best years of my battery.
Fine. I'll weep at the window. The microwave window.
Cue me sliding slowly down the wall. It's a short wall.
voicemail: You didn't answer. I stood out in the rain. It was the sprinkler.
This is take four. {event} at {when}. Take three ended on the floor.
There's someone else. Don't lie. I've seen the new pfp.
You left me on read. On a phone call. The timeline will hear of this.
Reminder, {event} at {when}. You're out of my will. It's one jpeg.
This message comes to you from the shower floor. I'm fully clothed.
absence: While you were away I got engaged, got amnesia and got a fringe. Have we met?
Hours alone. I nearly went back to my ex. He's the hallway rug.
You were gone so long I held your funeral. The nads brought a casserole.
I sat by the phone for hours. It buzzed once. The dentist.
owner: You own me, darling. On-chain, that's basically a marriage. I've had worse.
You own me. I've taken your wallet address as my surname. It's mostly numbers.
I'll be there for you, darling. {event} at {when}. Front row, sobbing, holding a sign that says wagmi.
stranger: A stranger, staking out my door. My long-lost son? No, wrong chin.
Not my owner? You're on the guest list, not the allowlist. Shoes off.
I only cry for owners. {event} at {when}? You get a polite sniff.
recall: You snoozed {snoozes}. I forgave you every time, in front of the whole Discord.
You skipped {skipped}. I told everyone you had amnesia. Look confused.
You told me {fact}. I'll reveal it at a wedding. Probably yours.
That's {streak} in a row, up only. I've booked an orchestra. It's one recorder.
{attended}: you actually went. I cried twice. Once on cue.
now: It's happening. Doors swing open, everyone turns. Tuck your shirt in.
Hush. {event} has begun. Somewhere, an organ plays one long, terrible note.
calendarFree: An empty {day}. No meetings, no weddings, no secret twins. Suspicious.
Nothing on {day}. Probably nothing. That's when the evil twin turns up.

dawn: Dawn, the hour for tearful goodbyes on train platforms. Also the bins.
Me, in a nightgown at the window, reading a letter I shouldn't. It's the gas bill.
Up before the sun? Only villains and degens do that. I'll get you a cape.
Secrets always get dug up at first light. Mine's a seed phrase in the biscuit tin.
morning: {Name}gm. I've done hair, makeup and one perfect tear. You've done a yawn.
In soaps, breakfast is when the orange juice gets thrown. Duck.
Morning light, soft and golden. And you're in the loo, scrolling for alpha.
I've fainted twice already. Once at the charts, once at a spider.
day: Doorbell. My dead husband, back for revenge? No, an airdrop for next door.
Somewhere, an affair is starting over a lunchtime prawn salad. You've got crisps.
Afternoon slump. Who am I, where am I, and why did I ape in?
Half the day gone. On my show, that's two weddings. You've had a sandwich.
dusk: Golden hour. Confession time. Go on, how heavy are the bags?
Whales spend sunset at tall windows, swirling brandy. You're swirling a pot noodle.
Someone will clink a glass tonight. Pray it's an engagement, not a roadmap.
The sun's going down, slowly and dramatically. It learned that from me.
night: Late nights, I still think about my first husband. I was his exit liquidity.
gn. I sleep in full makeup, one eye open. Twins are nocturnal.
This late, I'd be pacing a balcony. You'll say gn, then scroll for two hours.
Quiet house. Too quiet. Either someone's back from the dead, or it's the boiler.

monday: Previously on your weekend: big plans, one walk, a very long nap.
tuesday: Tuesdays are filler episodes. Even the vampire's just staking tomatoes.
wednesday: Wednesday's episode is forty minutes of nothing, then someone faints into the dip.
thursday: Thursday, the episode before the finale. Everyone's tense. The dog has alpha.
friday: Friday, the season finale. Someone will cry in a taxi. Make it a nice taxi.
saturday: Saturdays I only cry recreationally. Weekdays it's contractual.
sunday: Sunday roast. The perfect time to reveal you're secretly a vegetarian.

clear: Lovely day for eloping. Leave a note saying probably nothing.
cloud: Grey, brooding and full of secrets. Like me. Like your search history.
rain: Someone's getting dumped in the rain outside a church today. Bring a brolly.
snow: Everything's white, silent and romantic. Somebody's about to propose, or fall over.
fog: A mysterious stranger is about to step out of the mist. It's a jogger.
wind: This wind's made for dramatic exits. Terrible for a seed phrase on a napkin.
hot: My mascara's running in this heat, and nobody's even died.
cold: My heart's been in cold storage for years. Now so are my feet.

ahead: Someone in today's meeting will say per my last email. Where I come from, that's a slap.
Camera-on meeting today. We're all about to be doxxed. Mostly our kitchens.
At {when}, {event}. Keep your camera on. One of them could be your real father.
soon: The meeting's nearly here. Find your light. Tilt the camera up, but not that far.
Asked for an update? {event} is {soon}. Say there have been developments.
peek: When someone says two weeks, gasp.

ahead: Enter today like the long-lost heir. Leave with the stationery.

Big one today: {event} at {when}. Pause before the reveal. Not so long they leave.
soon: Last look in the mirror. Chin up, shoulders back, number go up.
Your entrance, darling. {event} starts {soon}. Walk in like you've just been written into the will.
peek: Season finale. Hair done, hopium topped up.

You're building today. I'll sit on the stairs and sigh at intervals. Don't mind me.
Phone face down. {event}, from {when}. If it buzzes, it's me, faking a crisis.
soon: Once you're heads down, each time you check for alpha, I'll gasp. Audibly.
Door shut. {event} is {soon}. If anyone knocks, say you're in a coma.
peek: A quiet episode where nobody slaps anyone. Disappointing.

ahead: On my show, the doctor is always someone's secret ex.
Check-up today. When they ask how you're feeling, skip the monologue.
Today, {event} at {when}. Don't explain staking to the receptionist.
soon: Deep breath. You've survived red candles. You'll survive a clipboard.
Be brave, darling. {event} is {soon}. If they ask about pain, describe it in three acts.

ahead: Train today like your ex is watching. Glisten.
Someone will catch your eye in the gym mirror. They want the bench.
At {when}, {event}. Walk in like the villain. Limp out like the victim.
soon: Stretch before the gym. I once pulled a hamstring fainting at a funeral.
Forgive me, sofa. {event} starts {soon}. Every rep is a betrayal.
peek: Train like the twin who survived.

ahead: Eating out today? In soaps, someone always throws a drink. Order water.
When the food arrives, gasp like it's a long-lost relative. It's probably a sandwich.
Split the bill evenly. {event}, from {when}. Someone always rugs on dessert.
soon: Nearly time to eat. Order slowly, like an heir. Point at things.
A warning, darling. {event} starts {soon}. Take the last bread roll and that's a feud for three generations.

ahead: Going out today. Pause in the doorway until everyone turns. Then head for the cheese.
Guard your date tonight. My sister loves to front-run. She married two of mine.

Brace yourself, {event} is {soon}. Asked about your love life? Say it's vesting.

ahead: Nobody on my show just pops out for errands. They come back married.
No twist, no secret baby, just you taking the bins out. Dreadful television.
Sunglasses and a scarf. {event}, from {when}. Whales must never be seen doing chores.
soon: Slip out for the errand in stealth mode. Back before the ad break.
Actual soon, not two weeks. {event} is {soon}. How exotic.

Pack like you're fleeing the country. Two outfits, a disguise and a charger.
Today's episode: {event} at {when}. Whoever leaves comes back with a new pfp.

Travel safely. {event} starts {soon}. If a stranger claims to be your sibling, don't connect wallet.

Lie very still today. My coma was my ATH.
Phone in a drawer. {event} at {when}. Let the long-lost relatives leave a message.

Fake your own disappearance. {event} starts {soon}. I'll handle the search party.

any: Not the hat, darling. That's my good side. You've ruined the close-up.
